macros.name: DefineFileInfoSVN
macros.doc: Defined a set of macros which provide the information collected by a previous \Provides... macro.

macros.name: filebase
macros.doc: File base name (file name without extension).

macros.name: fileinfo
macros.doc: The macros \fileversion and \fileinfo hold the file version and description taken from optional argument of the \Provide...SVN macro.

macros.name: filetoday
macros.doc: The \filetoday macro generates a text representation of the \filedate using the \today macro.

macros.name: fileversion
macros.doc: The macros \fileversion and \fileinfo hold the file version and description taken from optional argument of the \Provide...SVN macro.

macros.name: Rev
macros.doc: File revision followed by a space.
